an5.55:2.2: “Here, sir, a mother and son had both entered the rainy season residence at Sāvatthī,
an5.55:2.3: as a monk and a nun. They wanted to see each other often. The mother wanted to see her son often, and the son his mother.
an5.55:2.4: Seeing each other often, they became close. Being so close, they became familiar. And being familiar, lust overcame them. With their minds swamped by lust, without resigning the training and declaring their inability to continue, they had sex.”
an5.55:5.4: ‘An all-round snare of Māra’ is what one should rightly say of ladies:
